[Unit]
Description=Garmin frozen research traces, lossless read-only compressed view
After=local-fs.target

[Mount]
What=/root/garmin/archives/research-traces-v1.squashfs
Where=/root/garmin/archives/research-traces-v1
Type=squashfs
Options=loop,ro,nodev,nosuid,noexec
TimeoutSec=30

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
